translations.web: Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
translations.bsb: The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.
translations.kjv: CHETH. Thou art my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.
translations.asv: HHETH. Jehovah is my portion: I have said that I would observe thy words.
